c74object.name: el.pulser~
c74object.description:
el.pulser~ is a band-limited pulse waveform synthesizer built with additive harmonic summation. It synthesizes a pulse wave with variable pulse width by summing sinusoidal partials whose relative amplitudes and phases are determined by the pulse width parameter (ranging from 0.0 to 1.0). Because it is generated additively from a specified number of harmonics (up to 256), it avoids the harsh aliasing distortion typical of non-band-limited pulse waves. Both frequency and pulse width can be controlled via float messages or modulated continuously at audio rate.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / float / messages): Fundamental frequency in Hertz, and control message inlet (harmonics, mute).
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Pulse width (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.5). Controls the duty cycle and harmonic spectrum.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Synthesized pulse wave audio output.

inlet.description: Sets fundamental oscillator frequency in Hertz. Also receives control messages (harmonics, mute).
Sets the pulse width duty cycle between 0.0 and 1.0 (default: 0.5). Accepts float messages or audio-rate modulation signals.

outlet.description: The synthesized band-limited pulse wave audio output.

objarg.name: frequency
objarg.description: Initial fundamental frequency in Hertz (default: 440.0 Hz).

objarg.name: harmonic-count
objarg.description: The number of additive harmonics to synthesize (default: 8, range: 1 to 256).

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 1 sets fundamental frequency in Hertz. Float sent to inlet 2 sets pulse width (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: harmonics
method.description: Sets the number of additive harmonic partials to generate (range: 1 to 256). Output gain is automatically scaled to prevent clipping as harmonic count changes.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal pulse synthesis resumes.

method.name: signal
method.digest: Audio-rate frequency or pulse width modulation
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 controls frequency in Hertz. Signal arriving at inlet 2 continuously modulates the pulse width (0.0 to 1.0) at audio rate.
